profile.capacity_note: Contractor page describes dual 2 MW generators in a paralleling configuration as backup power infrastructure; not an official critical IT load figure and not written as a capacity_obs row this session.
profile.research_note: [batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This is the Tennessee South Data Center in Smyrna, Rutherford County, Tennessee, part of the State of Tennessee's IT organization. Project documentation from ABEC Electric, the electrical contractor that built the facility power infrastructure, describes a roughly 50,000 square foot building with 25,000 square feet of raised floor data center space, completed around 2016, with dual utility feeds, dual 2 megawatt generators in a paralleling configuration, and redundant UPS systems. This facility should not be confused with the separate Tennessee State Data Center operated by the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, which despite the similar name is the state's affiliate site in the US Census Bureau's State Data Center program, a statistical data dissemination network unrelated to physical IT infrastructure. No published megawatt or IT capacity figure specific to critical IT load was found from a tier one state government source. This research was carried out at the operator level in an earlier phase of this project.
